content: Fażl Allāh arrived in Isfahan around 766/1365 and quickly became famous as a dream interpreter. Nāfajī's Khwābnāma has Khwāja Ṣadr al-Dīn Turka telling him a dream, which Fażl Allāh read as meaning he should abandon a plan to write a book harmonizing religion and philosophy; that afternoon Afżal al-Dīn told a dream and received a cap from Fażl Allāh (Vatican MS Persian 17 ff. 32a-33a).
